title: "You Are Rejected!": An Empirical Study of Large Language Models Taking Hiring Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Administering a 216-question standardized hiring personality assessment to LLMs and comparing their self-evaluated responses to company-referenced human answers using Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and Pearson Correlation, which revealed a systematic tendency for models to select overly positive or highly idealistic options.

Prompting LLMs to act as HR managers to evaluate completed candidate personality tests, which demonstrated a lack of discriminative judgment and a systematic reluctance to assign 'Not Recommended' ratings to any candidate.
